deterministic_mean_action_change.scope: Direct deterministic network outputs before IK; changes alone do not prove a capture-rate improvement

home_comparison.scope: Canonical simulator episode reset before visible drives. Measured home state repeatability and target consistency are reported separately; retained path flags describe reset eligibility, not a physical home trajectory. No score rows are removed and no physical calibration/collision certificate is implied.

scope: CPU checkpoint/input/likelihood/reward/update-membership audit only; native telemetry rescoring and optimizer arithmetic are separate

support_evidence.scope: Independent anchor ranking/probe arithmetic/provenance checks; no replay of IK or capsule checks and no complete box feasibility certificate

coordinate_scope: Likelihoods/entropy use normalized residual actions. The fixed per-context affine physical-density Jacobian cancels in PPO ratios. Independent affine decoding verifies every requested action; no retries/projection remove failures.
held_out_scope: Held out from reward optimization only. Geometry-only support uses each known bucket coordinate, including validation/test; not globally unseen contexts.

comparison.scope: Matched one-seed nominal-layout comparison; geometry-informed action support changes the proposal distribution. Include geometry precompute cost. No new-layout/noise robustness or physical validation claim.
